title: Unit, Integration, Contract & E2E
objectives: Place tests on the pyramid by scope and speed
Choose the cheapest level that catches a given bug
Explain why coverage percentage is not quality

examples.name: pyramid.rs

exercise.prompt: Place each bug at its cheapest catching level: "pricing formula wrong", "service + SQL schema mismatch", "API field renamed by provider", "checkout flow broken across pages".
hints: Pure logic bugs are unit territory.
Cross-system journeys need E2E; provider drift is a contract concern.

questions.prompt: A teammate celebrates 100% line coverage. The right response is…
options: check that tests assert behavior, not just execute lines
questions.explanation: Coverage measures execution, not assertion quality; assertion-free tests inflate the number.

questions.prompt: An API provider renames a JSON field your client reads. Which level is DESIGNED to catch this?
questions.explanation: Contract tests pin the agreed wire shape and fail when producer or consumer drifts.
